  open class Animal(val name: String)
  class Cat() : Animal(<1 args>)
  class Dog() : Animal(<1 args>)
  class RefBox<T>(val value: T)
  struct ValueBox<T>
    field value: T
  enum Choice<T>
    Item(T)
    Empty
  enum Switch
    On
    Off
  fun returned(): Option<Animal>
    =
      Call Some
        Call Cat
  fun branched(flag: Boolean): Option<Animal>
    =
      IfExpression
        Var flag
        Call Some
          Call Cat
        else
        Var None
  fun selected(switch: Switch): Choice<Animal>
    =
      WhenExpression
        Var switch
        arm Switch.On()
          MethodCall Item
            Var Choice
            Call Cat
        arm Switch.Off()
          FieldAccess Empty
            Var Choice
  fun recovered(): Option<Animal>
    =
      TryExpression
        Call Some
          Call Cat
        catch e: UnwrapException
          Var None
  fun choose<T>(first: T, second: T): T
    =
      IfExpression
        BoolLiteral true
        Var first
        else
        Var second
